items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: And because I was thinking the time when I left Denver, Colorado, that's when I left George Morrison's band

ctx.x: The next year I came down and they said you were in Philadelphia. I didn't even have your address. That's why that money I owed you all those years. I didn't even know where you were except they said you were in Philadelphia.

Well I was living in North Philly. I lived on 12th and Girard. See, I even bought a home over there. I bought a nice home over there. And because I was thinking the time when I left Denver, Colorado, that's when I left George Morrison's band, you know, like I told you. Well I came to Philadelphia after that and I started working with Henry Lowe's band. That's the secretary of the local out there. Well I played with his band and played a nice long time.
I was going to ask about recordings. In the old days they didn't make many records here I guess.
